text:
marta: Proposal: "tenant-cordon" pattern to surgically isolate noisy/high-heat tenants from the shared hotpath. idea is a lightweight routing fence that directs selected tenants to a dedicated execution surface (same binaries, different pool). goal: limit KV cache churn and per-tenant tail impact.

owen: high-level rollout?

marta: Stage A: wire routing flag + tag tenants as "cordoned" (no runtime change). Stage B: route 1% traffic for cordoned tenants to dedicated pool in shadow. Stage C: route live traffic for selected tenants, monitor for 72h, expand.

claire: migration pain: prefixes and tenant heuristics live in enrichment. how do we keep behavior parity?

marta: We'll maintain a parity shim that proxies enrichment calls to legacy path for cordoned tenants during rollout. run diff harness on sampled sessions.

sre-bot: note: add automatic fallback if p95 increases >25% for cordoned tenant compared to baseline for 10m.

owen: cost: dedicated pool means reserved capacity. suggest starting with smallest noisy tenants and measure cost-per-req delta.

marta: agreed. will prepare cost delta table and a tenant candidacy rubric. main unknown: extra network hops for prefix reads.

claire: observability needs: per-tenant p50/p95, cache-hit, prefix-read latency, enrichment-proxy errors, output diffs. tag traces with "cordon=true".

marta: sample config for routing weights we can reuse in console:
```
route:
  selector: tenant
  rules:
    - tenants: [tenant:heavy-a, tenant:heavy-b]
      target_pool: cordoned-pool-v1
    - default: legacy-pool
```

sre-bot: infra: created ticket ARCH-7801 "tenant-cordon rollout" assigned to marta.

owen: test harness: replay 20k sessions for each candidate tenant against both pools with jitter and assert label drift <0.3% and latency tail within SLO.

marta: fallback behavior: if cordoned pool signals degraded (error rate or p95 breach), router will fail open to legacy pool for that tenant for 5m and notify oncall.

claire: Also consider cache warming strategy: backfill top-k prefixes per tenant and allow lazy-writes for cold misses. track warmup curve.

marta: timeline: 1 week prototype (routing + shim), 2 weeks pilot on 3 tenants, 4-8 weeks gradual expansion. will write RFC follow-up and tag reviewers @owen @claire. :memo:
